title: 349 repeat original Commons Text CI with normal local host resolution
description: Reproduce the same original Maven lifecycle and exact Git revision pair on JDK 21 in a networkless guest with localhost and its own hostname in /etc/hosts. The first full run reached 1305 tests on each side with 18 lookup errors. This isolates missing machine-local name service from tests requiring a real external site. Retain all suite counts and all 34 StringEscapeUtils outcomes.
expected: The same suite and named CSV coverage are measured on both real artifacts. Record any remaining external-service dependency explicitly.

resources.notes: The first full Linux run reached 1305 tests per side in 2m20s and peaked at 13.9 GiB. Preserve the matched 16 GiB hard limit and 4 CPUs; the shared Maven artifact cache is warm.

steps.name: Run the two original CI processes with ordinary loopback identity
